units.function: Health endpoint tests for DB reachability, build/cloud metadata, backup warnings/redaction, authenticated detail and initial-admin bootstrap state.
units.dependencyDirection: Express/Supertest calls the real health router with fake DB queries, runtime environment and temporary backup/failure files.
units.keyDataModels: Health status/version/commit/serverInfo/cloud projection, database backup warning, deployment mode/exposure, bootstrap status/invite and actor type.
units.lifecycle: Probe health as local, anonymous authenticated or authenticated board caller; classify DB failure, backup degradation and bootstrap readiness.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 15/15 with PAPERCLIP_HOME isolated under /private/tmp. Redaction and DB 503 cases are strong; Agent detail, dev restart authorization, timeouts/load, corrupt backups, readiness semantics, cleanup and schema compatibility are absent.
units.designRationale: Serve deployment probes and operator diagnostics from one route while reducing anonymous metadata leakage in authenticated/public mode.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs distinct, stable liveness/readiness/degraded/operator diagnostics across managed-cloud and self-hosted profiles without exposing responsibility or infrastructure data.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the anonymous redaction and stable backup warning-code tests. Add separate endpoint contracts, Agent-vs-human permission cases, bounded dependency probes, corruption/restore evidence, rate behavior and mutating-control denial tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: The tests equate any authenticated board/Agent with full operational visibility and do not bind remediation or restart authority to an accountable human.
evidence: 2026-08-18 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest with isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME: 15/15 passed

units.function: Combined health/diagnostics router plus a file-mediated dev-server restart control endpoint.
units.dependencyDirection: Public/actor request context drives database probes and projections; filesystem backup/dev status and instance settings feed diagnostics; POST writes a restart request.
units.keyDataModels: Actor/deployment exposure, DB/bootstrap state, server/git/cloud metadata, backup health warnings, active runs/dev-server state and restart request.
units.lifecycle: Authorize detail level, probe dependencies, compute bootstrap/dev/backup projections, redact or expose full response; separately accept and persist a restart request.
units.testAssessment: The reviewed health suite passes but leaves Agent overexposure, control authorization, unbounded dependency work and readiness/degraded behavior unproven; separate pending dev-server tests will be audited independently.
units.designRationale: Give load balancers, Cloud orchestration, developers and authenticated operators one convenient introspection surface.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs low-cost public probes, protected diagnostics and accountable control actions for cloud/local control and execution planes.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE_ONLY. Split pure constant-time liveness, bounded readiness, permissioned operator diagnostics and separately authorized/audited restart commands. Agents must receive only capability-scoped projections, not board-equivalent infrastructure details.
units.responsibilityConflict: Any board actor can request dev-server restart and any authenticated Agent receives full operational details. Neither visibility nor process mutation is linked to a responsible human, approval, work/action digest or evidence.
evidence: existing completed application:server/index.ts assessment covers composition/scheduled backup startup without rereading source
